hero.title: MIRA: The Neuro-Symbolic Decisioning Engine
hero.subtitle: Transform complex policy terms into automated, fully-deterministic claim decisions. Every outcome traceable to the legal text.
hero.description: Works alongside existing claims systems. Integrates without disruption.

problem.title: Claim Decisions are Still Manual, Inconsistent and Opaque
problem.paragraph1: Today's claim handlers spend hours interpreting dense policy language.
problem.paragraph2: Decisions vary by handler and audit preparation consumes weeks.
problem.paragraph3: Probabilistic AI tools can't explain their reasoning.

solution.title: Agentic AI Meets Deterministic Logic
solution.description: MIRA is the world's first neuro-symbolic engine purpose-built for insurance claims. It uses agentic AI for intelligent workflow orchestration (reading documents, extracting data, identifying parties etc) while relying on deterministic logic for the actual coverage decision.
solution.result: The result: decisions that are fast, consistent and completely explainable.

workflow.title: How MIRA Works
workflow.subtitle: Five steps from document to decision

1.title: Ingestion
1.description: Key data placed into the computable contract from emails, PDFs, photos, scanned notes etc.

2.title: Comprehension
2.description: Agentic workflow reads case file: identifies parties, creates timeline, extracts key data etc.

3.title: Determination
3.description: Deterministic logic evaluates coverage status: Covered | Partially Covered | Not Covered | Additional Information Required

4.title: Action
4.description: Tasks executed: open claim, set reserves, draft payment, draft communications etc.

5.title: Output
5.description: Auditable outputs: coverage report, customer letter with rationale, audit log, reserve recommendation etc.

hero.title: ContextBuilder: From Unstructured Documents to Trusted Data
hero.subtitle: A claims document pipeline that turns PDFs, scans and images into structured, quality-checked claim data, with human review where it matters.

problem.title: The Document Chaos Problem
problem.description: Claims arrive as chaotic document bundles: blurry photos, multi-page PDFs, scanned forms. Extracting accurate data is slow, error-prone and expensive.

solution.title: Purpose-Built Pipeline for Claims
solution.description: ContextBuilder is a purpose-built pipeline for claims documents. It automatically ingests, classifies and extracts data, then applies quality gates to surface exceptions for human review.
solution.result: The result: claim-ready "context packs" that downstream systems can trust.

pipeline.title: 5-Step Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: From raw documents to structured data

1.title: Ingest
1.description: Transforms documents into machine-readable text and layout using advanced OCR and vision models.

2.title: Classify
2.description: Identifies document type and language to route correctly: loss notice, police report, invoice etc.

3.title: Extract
3.description: Pulls structured fields based on document type. Normalizes so same concept looks the same everywhere.

4.title: Quality Gates
4.description: Automated checks validate completeness and consistency. Pass / Warn / Fail scoring.

5.title: QA Console
5.description: Human-in-the-loop review workspace. Quickly confirm, correct and label documents.

problem.title: The Sampling Problem
problem.description: Traditional QA relies on random sampling, checking a small percentage of claims. Patterns slip through. Leakage compounds. Training gaps persist.
